title: 36 Hours in Palm Springs, Calif.
abstract: After some hard-earned changes, the desert town nestled in the Coachella Valley is becoming a destination for laid-back cool once again.

title: 36 Hours in Birmingham, Ala.
abstract: The city still has an ability to surprise the uninitiated, particularly for modern visitors who arrive with collective memories of the city’s violent civil rights past.

title: 36 Hours in Barcelona
abstract: Spending a few well-chosen days among this Spanish city’s streets and shadowy alleyways will provide you with a crash course in what’s hot now.

title: 36 Hours in Oakland, Calif.
abstract: For visitors willing to give the city a chance, the rewards are plenty: Art Deco architecture, stunning views and a lively mix of cultures.
